dedupe_keys.name: genesys mod germany technology demand and renewable data

description: This dataset contains renewable potentials, time series, technology data and additional tables for the Germany implementation of GENeSYS-MOD. The deposit provides model input data, while the related GENeSYS-MOD catalogue record describes the energy optimisation model. The original native title bounds the geographical coverage to Germany. The inspected description does not state the input years, technology classes, units, time step or table schema. It also does not establish that this deposit reproduces every later model release. Konstantin Löffler, Thorsten Burandt and Karlo Hainsch deposited 25 CSV files, available free from Zenodo under CC BY 4.0. File descriptors identify capital, fixed and variable costs, annual demand, renewable potentials and several generation and demand time series; these file contents were not inspected. The source establishes a concrete role in parameterising German energy-system simulations. No independent validation or comparison with current national energy statistics is documented in the inspected metadata.
